functions.title: Job Descriptions
content: Analyze system requirements and provide functional support.
Work on functional design, process design, prototyping, testing, training and defining support procedures.
Interact with clients and account managers to acquire and work out feasible requirement plans.
Develop, document, and revise system design procedures, test procedures and quality standards.
Perform market and competitor analysis.

Apply expertise in quantitative analysis in dependent research, data mining and the presentation of data to understand customers’ needs/specifications and how they interact with our business products.
Customize and manage integration tools, databases and analytical systems.
Manage and structure data.
Provide support to the development team with knowledge of data infrastructure and imaging/spatial analysis.
Provide technical support to the engineering team for daily maintenance.
Initiate customized product testing plans to meet client demand.

functions.title: Requirement
content: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or a related discipline with at least 6 months experiences.
Must have skills in Law Enforcement and Public Safety Domain Knowledge, GIXML interface solutions, Low code development and maintenance of Police & Fire RMS systems.
Advanced SQL with performance tuning.

functions.title: Job Descriptions
content: Responsible for the end to end development life cycle and continuous maintenance of Infoshare software products.
Gather overall requirements of assigned projects and coordinate the support of UI/UX design, hard code development and QA efforts from specific teams.
Develop the deployment flow control strategy to optimize customer satisfaction.
Participate in advancing low-code development, optimizing data pipelines and refining document templates and interfaces.
Enhance software functionalities, streamline processes, and elevate user experience.
Provide support of existing Infoshare web applications including troubleshooting, testing, business rule changes, and routine tasks.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive innovation, ensure scalability and maintain a high product standard and excellence.

functions.title: Requirement
content: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Data Analytics Engineering or Mathematics or a related discipline with at least12 months experience.
Must have training or practical skills in Law Enforcement & Public Safety domain knowledge, GJXML interface, low code development, and UI/UX design.
Advanced SQL.
